messages:
nina: hey @devex, hitting a weird 403 on the starter sample app after creating a workspace. quickstart steps: npm i @redwood/inference && export REDWOOD_API_KEY=... && node sample.js. response is 403 with message 'workspace: default_permissions_missing'
chris_eng: can you paste the exact curl or SDK call and the returned headers?
nina: here's the exact minimal repro: 
```js
// sample.js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
client.generate({ model: 'gpt-open-1', prompt: 'hi' })
  .then(r => console.log(r))
  .catch(e => console.error(e.message, e.response && e.response.body));
```
Error payload: 
```json
{"error":"403","message":"workspace: default_permissions_missing","hint":"enable_api_access or add billing method"}
```
samir_support: thanks — quick Q: did you accept the workspace TOS and add a billing method during setup? new orgs sometimes get a 'limited' role until billing is configured.
nina: i clicked 'Create workspace' in the UI and got redirected to onboarding screens. thought the free credits would show up but it kept me on the page. haven't added a card.
chris_eng: that fits. There's also been a parity bug where the Node SDK returns a 403 body with 'default_permissions_missing' but the UI shows a different prompt. cc @maria to check if the onboarding screens are flaky.
maria: looking into logs for the org id you pasted in DM. quick note: devex team toggled a gate last week to block API calls for orgs without billing+tos accepted — short-term safety measure. ideally we should show a clearer error on the SDK (right now it's opaque).
devex-bot: For reference, rollout: onboarding-gate v2 enabled 2026-02-14 14:03 UTC — blocks unauthenticated or unconfirmed orgs from generate endpoints.
nina: ok makes sense. two asks: 1) can we improve SDK error text (hint about 'accept workspace TOS / add billing')? 2) is there a temporary CLI flag or header to bypass for local dev?
chris_eng: for 1) yes — filed: DEVEX-1129 to include a structured hint and doc link in the SDK error. For 2) we intentionally disallow bypass in hosted envs. But in Dedicated / Private you can configure relaxed onboarding. For now, you can create a test org and add a billing method or use the hosted sandbox account we give to new signups.
samir_support: i'll DM a sandbox token you can use for testing. also adding a short note to the quickstart README about this gating so others don't get confused.
nina: thanks — that would have saved me 30 minutes. small PR suggestion: change error message to include "visit /orgs/{id}/settings/onboarding" link if present.
maria: agreed. adding to DEVEX-1129. also will ask product to add an inline CTA in the onboarding flow.
chris_eng: follow-up — adding a tiny sample to the starter that checks for this error and prints a clear action message. will open PR later today. :+1:
